overview: 针对高精度足式运动中端到端优化不足及反应式控制滞后的问题，本文提出了LocoWM框架。该方法引入行动条件世界模型，通过预测未来物理状态序列来指导残差适配器，从而主动生成动作修正以补偿预期偏差。研究采用两阶段训练策略，实现了基本运动能力学习与高精度补偿任务的解耦，实验表明该方法在地形平整、加速度补偿及抗干扰能力方面优于对比基线。

highlights.text: LocoWM通过行动条件世界模型预测未来状态，实现了高精度运动的预主动式残差适配。
highlights.evidence: A base policy provides command-following locomotion, while an action-conditioned world model predicts a sequence of future physical states from proprioceptive history and the proposed base action. A residual adapter conditions on this predicted sequence to generate additive action corrections that compensate for anticipated deviations.

highlights.text: 通过两阶段训练策略，将基本运动能力的获取与精密任务的适配过程分离开来。
highlights.evidence: Two-stage training first learns locomotion and action-conditioned dynamics, then freezes both modules while training the adapter, separating locomotion acquisition from precision adaptation.

highlights.text: 在地形平整、加速度补偿及抗干扰等测试中，表现出比端到端和反应式残差基线更高的控制精度。
highlights.evidence: Experiments spanning terrain leveling, acceleration compensation, and push recovery demonstrate improved control precision and disturbance robustness over end-to-end and reactive residual baselines.
